items.title: Coventry latest: No tackles for 69 mins - but Lampard happy with effort

items.title: 'Liverpool's best XI is still better than Man Utd's' | Carra and Nev clash on who is looking better!
items.description: Jamie Carragher believes Liverpool boast a stronger starting eleven than Manchester United heading into the 2026/27 Premier League season, but says the Reds still need to add depth and quality before the transfer window closes.

items.title: PL predictions: Brentford to give Spurs a reality check

items.title: Man Utd latest: Carrick on protecting Bruno and CL hopes

items.description: The Friday Night Football panel discuss whether Arsenal are still shy of a world-class attacker that would see them get over the line to win their first UEFA Champions League title.

items.title: Lampard praises Coventry's courage in 3-0 defeat by Arsenal
items.description: Coventry City manager Frank Lampard shares his thoughts on his side's 3-0 defeat by Arsenal in their first game back in the Premier League since 2001.

items.title: Arsenal cruise to victory over Coventry on Premier League return
